title: Timmy and Cricket's Cozy Rain
markdown:
Once upon a time, Timmy the teddy bear lived in a little house. Every day, Timmy and Cricket the cat sat on their porch with warm milk. They loved the gentle breeze and the soft hum of crickets.

One day, soft, gray clouds came. A gentle pitter-patter began on the roof. It was a new sound! Timmy’s fur danced, and Cricket’s ears wiggled.

Timmy and Cricket looked at each other. "The new sound is funny!" Timmy whispered. Cricket said, "Mew?" They decided to move inside for their warm milk.

Because of that good choice, the rain’s pitter-patter sounded like a happy song from inside. They sat by the big window. The rain made lovely shapes on the glass. It was so peaceful and snuggly.

Timmy and Cricket held their warm milk. The rain was a sweet, happy sound. Timmy leaned his soft head on Cricket. Cricket purred, a low, happy sound. They felt safe, warm, and cozy. Everything was just right.

Ever since then, when gentle rain fell, Timmy and Cricket found their cozy spot inside. They listened to the rain’s sleepy lullaby, feeling safe, warm, and happy, together.
characters: Timmy the teddy, Cricket the cat
